mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over the prior 6 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer spending, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the prior 12 months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines by more than 2% over 12 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 5.0% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based weakening in demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 3 months
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals improving supply capacity, which reduces inflationary pressures and supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO rises by more than 2% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month rise in both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines for 3 months
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
